messages:
Ivy H: Support reported a user couldn't finish quickstart. They copied the top curl and got a 401 'insufficient_scope'.
Ben C: Can you paste exactly what they ran?
Ivy H: From README 'Make your first request':
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-redwood-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Zara N: Two things jump out: (1) scoped API keys now require explicit 'inference.write' for POSTs and README doesn't mention it, (2) sample-app and some snippets use REDWOOD_KEY instead of REDWOOD_API_KEY. Copy/paste mismatch. Also Windows cmd users will break on single quotes.
Ben C: I reproduced locally by rotating a token during a run. After rotation next request returned 401 with body `{\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\"}` and logs `auth: token present but missing scope: inference.write`.
Ivy H: Proposed tiny README edits: add a one-line "Auth scopes" note above the curl that says: "Ensure your key includes the inference.write scope for write requests (see Console -> API Keys)" and change the sample-app env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Zara N: Also add a short Windows example to avoid quoting footguns:
```
rem Windows CMD example
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" ^
  -H "Authorization: Bearer %REDWOOD_API_KEY%" ^
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" ^
  -d "{\"model\":\"gpt-redwood-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}"
```
Ben C: SDK parity gap: Node quickstart mentions auth retry behavior; Python and Go quickstarts do not. Suggest adding a 2-line 'Advanced: retries' note for each SDK plus a minimal Python snippet showing requests + urllib3 Retry.
Ivy H: I'll open a small PR that: (A) inserts the scope troubleshooting note, (B) standardizes env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY across samples, (C) adds the Windows curl example, (D) adds the Python retry blurb as parity.
Docs CI Bot: docs-ci: running linkcheck + sample linter for PR #1987 :eyes:
Zara N: Also add a one-line changelog at the top of README: "2026-03-20: clarified auth scopes, env var names, and retry guidance" so support can cite it.
Ben C: QA request: add a lightweight samples CI job that runs the quickstart on Linux and Windows runners and verifies the env var is present and the curl invocation succeeds (or errors with descriptive message). That will catch regressions around quoting and env var names.
Ivy H: Good call. I'll include the CI job in the PR and tag @Ben C for the smoke test. Leaving this thread open until merge. :thumbsup:
